title: Pipeline workforce for AGENT-02..10: per-agent task pool, result pool and batch Slice integration
problem: Under DEC-0017 each agent holds one task file; after delivering, an agent waits until the Manager reviews and assigns the next task, and the Manager handles every task one by one. The Manager becomes the throughput bottleneck.

options.summary: AGENT-02..10: the agent branch holds .arena/task-pool/ (tasks queued ahead by the Manager, READY or ASSIGNED-waiting by depends_on), .arena/current-task.md (pointer) and .arena/result-pool/ (delivered results with exact commit ranges). Agents run next → work → result → next without a Manager round trip; the Manager keeps pools filled, reads the integration queue per Slice, batch-integrates results onto the one Slice branch, opens one PR per Slice and marks tasks COMPLETED after the merge. AGENT-01 stays on the DEC-0017 single-task workflow until a separate MIGRATE-AGENT-01. Rollout in stages: AGENT-02 pilot, then AGENT-03..04, then AGENT-05..10.
Move all ten agents, including AGENT-01, to the pipeline at once.
Keep the DEC-0017 single task per agent for everyone.

rationale: Owner master prompt 2026-09-25 (PARALLEL WORKFORCE MODEL: TASK POOL → RESULT POOL): agents must not wait for the Manager between tasks, the Manager prepares work ahead and integrates in batches, AGENT-01 must not be disturbed while it finishes its milestone, and no new runtime (server, daemon, heartbeat, transport, enrollment) may be introduced. A satisfies all of it with files and git only. B would disturb AGENT-01. C keeps the bottleneck. Unchanged: DEC-0014 (one PR per Slice, 8 gates; READY_FOR_REVIEW is never COMPLETED), DEC-0015, DEC-0016, DEC-0017 (task authority on the agent branch; hybrid reassignment, now recorded with previous_owner / new owner / reason / timestamp), no new milestone numbers. Task authority for pipeline agents is .arena/task-pool/*, .arena/current-task.md and .arena/result-pool/* on the agent branch; the queue index on arena-manager is not authority.
